messages.author: arjun
messages.text: thinking about the tied-weight problem: two providers share the same weight and the random choice makes error spikes worse. proposal: break ties by recent error rate.

messages.author: sofia
messages.text: love it!! how big is the error window?

messages.author: arjun
messages.text:
rolling 10 min. small enough to react, big enough to not flap. sketch:
```
if weights tied:
    pick lowest error_rate(window=10m)
```
